description: Resume a PAUSED or HALTED crew from its last checkpoint. Pass `guidance` for "Resume with guidance": the Engineer's first resumed round runs with that text, in this one call. Guidance replaces the automatic recovery of a consumed amend that a plain resume of a crew halted at its ship gate runs; it does not run with it. A crew the guidance cannot reach is refused with not_resumable and the guidance is not stored: one that is not paused or halted, or one stopped at a gate (paused at any gate, or halted at the ship gate); use anyforge_amend_crew there. Requires `approve` scope.

guidance.description: Optional guidance for the Engineer, up to 4000 characters. Omit to resume as before.

name: anyforge_resume_crew
title: Resume crew
